# Fate UI v0.9.9-beta2

A hotfix over beta1. Memory Learning stays quiet unless you turn it on, and editing a queued message is just editing.

## Fixed

- Sending a prompt with Memory Learning off no longer fails with “Originating session changed before dispatch.” Enable off means pass-through, even if GLOBAL or PROJECT were left on.
- The composer chip is gone when learning is off. When Enable is on, only the brain icon remains; hover it to see which of GLOBAL and PROJECT are attached.
- Editing a queued message puts the text back in the composer and removes it from the queue. It is not labeled Recovered. Recovered is only for drafts that were still queued when Fate UI closed; those can be edited or discarded the same way, without the old banner above the input.

## Compatibility and downloads

This is a drop-in upgrade from 0.9.9-beta1. Memory Learning remains off until you enable it.

Native installers are verified and smoke-tested on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64 before publication. Public beta installers are unsigned; verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS` and back up important work before upgrading.
